arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS insufficient_balance_transactions FROM transactions WHERE errors = 'Insufficient Balance'
arguments.explanation: Counts the transactions whose recorded error is 'Insufficient Balance', across all the data.
assumptions: Counted across the full data range (2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31), not only March 2019 or online transactions from the earlier question.
Took 'failed because of an insufficient balance' to mean the errors column equals 'Insufficient Balance'.
